text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2: Elevated OOMs + GPU driver faults in asia-southeast-1 gpu-pool-c. Autoscaler showing ping-pong scaling (add -> remove -> add) starting ~02:12 UTC. Client-facing errors on streaming endpoints ~10-15% failure rate.

oncall-nina: joining. ack PD-INC-9001. tagging SRE + runtime + infra.

sre-jan: logs show a pattern: pod starts normal, after ~3-5 minutes hits high GPU memory, then `NVRM: Xid` followed by kube killing container. Node state briefly NotReady during kubelet restart. Also saw a couple of kernel panic oops in system logs.

eng-runtime-sam: looks like heavy KV cache rebuilds plus full attention contexts are blowing the footprint. Autoscaler cooldown is 45s which is too low for our workload shape. Thrash causes cold scheduling and memory spikes -> feedback loop.

observability-bot: quick links: https://dash.internal/ooms/gpu-pool-c
Important queries:
```
increase(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}[15m])
rate(nvidia_xid_errors_total[5m])
```

cs-ryan: several enterprise customers opened tickets complaining streams dropped. No SLA breach yet but priority-high. I'll prepare an incident banner.

oncall-nina: immediate plan: 1) quiet autoscaler (stabilization window 600s), 2) enable warm standby nodes (min 2), 3) throttle request concurrency from gateway for this pool, 4) cordon nodes with repeated Xid. Jan/Kate please execute.

sre-jan: cordoning flagged nodes now and collecting crash dumps. cmds: 
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-3-77-2.ap-southeast
kubectl drain ip-10-3-77-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
scp ops@10.3.77.2:/var/log/messages /tmp/node-77-messages.log
```

infra-kate: pausing the ASG scale policies and applying min=2 via infra API. applied patch: `asg.update(asg_name='gpu-pool-c', min=2, cooldown=600)`. Confirmed.

eng-runtime-sam: pushing a safe-mode runtime patch to reduce per-request context windows and disable aggressive KV prefetch: 
```
PATCH /runtime/v2/config
{"context_window_limit":1024, "kv_prefetch":false}
```
Should cut mem usage per convo by ~30%.

incident-bot: PD event PD-INC-9001 acknowledged by oncall-nina. Severity: SEV2.

observability-bot: after autoscaler suppression and runtime patch, rolling 1m metrics: 5xx -> 0.08 from 0.14, xid_errors reduced but still present on two older nodes.

sre-jan: found that two nodes are on older AMI with a kernel that triggers PCIe resets under load. Petitioning infra to reimage those hosts. Collected `dmesg` snippets and uploaded to `/incidents/3999990001/artifacts`.

infra-kate: confirmed partial image drift due to a failed rolling update last week. Kicking off targeted instance refresh for the affected ASG. ETA ~40m.

eng-runtime-sam: gateway rule: rate-limit pool-c bursts to reduce concurrent contexts. `gateway set-rate-limit --pool gpu-pool-c --concurrency 10` applied. Also enabled a temporary CPU-encoded fallback for lower-priority tenants.

cs-ryan: posted incident notice on status page and messaged affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA. template: "We're seeing GPU node instability causing intermittent failures to streaming endpoints. Mitigations are in progress. No data loss. Expect improved behavior in 30-60 minutes."

observability-bot: alert: pod-churn alarm suppressed; now chasing node-level Xid error counts. Panel: https://dash.internal/alerts/xid-spike.

eng-runtime-sam: deleting several crashlooping pods to force scheduling onto healthy nodes. note: cache warm cost will spike but better than repeated OOMs.

sre-jan: restarted nvidia-driver on two quarantined hosts and then drained them. still seeing occasional PCIe reset traces; reimage recommended.

incident-bot: tag: autoscaler-oscillation, gpu-xid-errors, kernel-drift.

infra-kate: started instance refresh job for ASG gpu-pool-c. rolling update strategy: 2 at a time, health-check wait 5m.

eng-runtime-sam: plan for traffic ramp: after 20m stable with Xid=0 and 5xx < 0.03, we'll move traffic back in 10% steps. Will keep quantized fallback for 1h.

sre-jan: follow-ups to create: 1) postmortem ticket with timeline + root cause hypotheses, 2) change to autoscaler to use predictive scale based on queue depth not just CPU/GPU alloc, 3) preflight AMI validation for driver/kernel combo. Creating PM-INC-9001.

oncall-nina: handoff rules: I'll stay for 30m more. If we hit stability criteria (no Xid, 5xx < 3%) we resolve and spin up follow-ups. If not, escalate to infra lead and Eng runtime manager.

cs-ryan: tracking customer P1s; prepping outreach after postmortem.

observability-bot: 02:52 UTC snapshot: 5xx at 0.027, xid_errors per node = 0 on newly refreshed hosts.

infra-kate: instance refresh progressing, 4/12 updated. no regressions so far.

incident-bot: incident timeline noted: 3999990001. Closing conditions defined.

oncall-nina: thanks everyone. keep updates to this thread only. we'll debrief after. :thumbsup:
